quests.title: Proof of Old Government House
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Nobody in Parramatta believes what Old Government House looks like at the last train. I have rung the number on the letter four times. Get me a photo close enough that council can't say it's somewhere else. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: get a picture of Old Government House before they fix it

quests.title: The Old Government House Tab
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Two chippies off the Old Government House job have run a tab in Parramatta since Monday. It started small, the way these things do. They drove past at knock-off without looking in, so settle it in cash. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: collect from the two chippies near Old Government House
and bring back thirty of it

quests.title: Something From the Parramatta River ferry
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. The stall at the Parramatta River ferry has run out and the customers keep coming. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Find something round Parramatta that'll do before the midnight rush. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: pick something up near the Parramatta River ferry
bring it to the stall

quests.title: The the Parramatta River ferry Order
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. The the Parramatta River ferry order came to seventy more than I'd budgeted and the supplier wants it by the last train. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Find seventy in Parramatta and photograph the receipt. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: square the seventy for the the Parramatta River ferry order
then photograph the receipt on the counter

quests.title: Tap On at Parramatta Square
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. My Opal says I owe nineteen dollars for a trip from Parramatta I never took on the last Sunday of the month. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Take the same one to Auburn and tell me what it charged you. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: tap on at Parramatta, tap off at Auburn
come back and tell me the fare

quests.title: The Length of Parramatta Square
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. I haven't walked Parramatta Square end to end since the light rail came to Parramatta. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Do it Saturday for me and photograph what's at the far end now. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: walk the length of Parramatta Square
to the far end
photograph what's there now

quests.title: Two From Church Street
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. Two of whatever's going near Church Street, here, hot, before the footy at the change of shift. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. It's Parramatta; I'm not asking for much. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: pick up two from near Church Street
and get them here hot

quests.title: Seven a.m. At Eat Street
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. The site at Eat Street starts its jackhammer at half four on a grand final day, which is illegal and loud. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Photograph it running and have a word with the Parramatta foreman. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: photograph the noise from Eat Street
and have a word with the foreman

quests.title: A Flat White From Parramatta Park
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. I want a flat white from the place near Parramatta Park, not the one next to it. I am aware how that sounds. Here by midnight, while it's still coffee and Parramatta still has some. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: get a flat white from the cafe near Parramatta Park
and bring it back before it's lukewarm

quests.title: Bin Night, CommBank Stadium
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Somebody moves the bins on CommBank Stadium in front of my drive every Anzac Day night. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Photograph the evidence and have a word; Parramatta knows who. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: photograph the bins at CommBank Stadium
and the woman who moved them

quests.title: RBT on the Riverside Theatres
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. There's a breath test set up on the Riverside Theatres since half four. I have rung the number on the letter four times. My brother-in-law needs the ute at the far end of Parramatta without a conversation. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: get past the breath test on the Riverside Theatres
then meet the ute at the far end

quests.title: Trouble at the Riverside Theatres
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Two lads and their mate decided at half six that the Riverside Theatres is theirs. It started small, the way these things do. The rest of Parramatta disagrees, so explain the disagreement. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: sort the pair near the Riverside Theatres
and the mate who joined in

quests.title: Cover at Old Government House
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. I've got nobody for the Old Government House shift at eight at night and a room full of Parramatta people who've paid. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Fifty of trade and one difficult person at the door. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: cover the fifty for the shift
and handle whoever's at the door

quests.title: Probationary at the Parramatta River ferry
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. A young constable has been doing his first solo patrol round the Parramatta River ferry since Melbourne Cup day. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. He's decided Parramatta is his, so give him a story for the sergeant. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: lose the probationary constable near the Parramatta River ferry

quests.title: One Stop From Parramatta Square
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. I need to know the train from Parramatta stops at Auburn and doesn't sail through like it did on Monday. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Ride it at six in the morning and photograph the sign. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: take the train to Auburn
and photograph the platform sign

quests.title: The Centenary Square Camera
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. A new speed camera near Centenary Square has fined half of Parramatta since the long weekend. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Photograph it for the appeal, then prove the train to Auburn is faster anyway. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: photograph the camera near Centenary Square
then take the train instead, to Auburn

quests.title: Race Four, Eat Street
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. There's a horse in race four at dawn that a bloke at Eat Street swears by. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Turn it into fifty-five somewhere in Parramatta and tell me if it came in. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: turn the tip into fifty-five
tell me if it came in
